investigation_notes.Description: Alert triggered by an external mention of Vitalis Healthcare found on a dark web (onion) repository. Evidence includes multiple paths explicitly referencing 'vitalis_healthcare' and filenames that indicate exposed patient records, financial claims processing data, and internal network topology and firewall rules. The combination of a dark web hosting context and apparent presence of PHI, financial, and IT configuration data represents a credible and significant exposure risk, so this alert is prioritized as High Priority for escalation and further investigation.
